description_text:
Detailed and realistic male outfit 45
File formats provided are OBJ, FBX & DAE
 Texture maps: Diffuse: 8192x8192px, Normal: 4096x4096px
Clothing will eventually fit most avatars with minor adjustments.
How to fit the clothing to DAZ characters:

  - Dial Genesis 8 Male Arms Up-Down to -45% and Legs Spread to -5% in Parameters

  - Go into bone edit mode, and when bones are visible select one, right click and go edit -> bake joint rotations

  - Use the transfer utility, set source item shape to current and add a smoothing modifier.

  - Save the clothing to your library. 

  - Clear the scene, add G8 Male again and add the outfit, it should now fit the zero-posed character.

Hope this helps,
Enjoy!

description_text:
- Low-poly and optimised for game engines

  - Rigged: inverse kinematics with control joints

  - Legs are rigged as pistons with Damped Track bone constraint

  - Fully animated walk cycle, loopable (e.g. see youtube preview)

  - 4K PBR Textures: Albedo, Metalness, Roughness, Specular, Transparency and Normal

  - All textures are in .PNG format and are packed into .blend file & a separate .zip file

  - Each part is a separate object with a proper name

  - Model consists of only quad-polygons, no N-gons

  - All UV's are non-overlapping and are unwrapped onto a single texture atlas

  - Model has a unified general PBR material assembled in Quixel Mixer

  - Rendered in real time with EEVEE renderer in Blender

  - The HDRI used for render is not included

  - Design inspired by Westworld Season 3

  - Fell free to contact me for additional infromation and have a great day!

PROPS SET for POSER-DAZ James-Simon-Michael4 STANDARD CHARACTERS. CHARACTERS NOT INCLUDED. [DAZ is a free Software].___________________________________________Greek Trireme Oarsman Props Set with 6 typical Greek Trireme Oarsman props. All 3D models ready for POSER James and Simon G2 and DAZ Michael 4. Faithful and accurate Reconstruction. C4D, 3DS, OBJ, POSER, DAZ, VUE6-7-8-9-10!_____________________________________________SmartCgArt is member of the Archaeological Institute of America [AIA].
Real World Scale Model [SmartCgArt Real World System]. Quads [C4D; OBJ; POSER/DAZ] & Tris [VUE;3DS].
Collection of 6 3D Models with 15 Photoreal and Alternate textures.3 complete Props Sets ready to be used with POSER [James, Simon G2] and DAZ [Michael 4 character][DAZ is a free Software].
Faithful and accurate Reconstruction of an Ancient Greece Trireme Oarsman Props Set to create an Ancient Greece Trireme Oarsman, according to the Scientific Data and the Archaeological Evidence.
Greek Triremes were designed so that it was easy to change crew and oarsmen rapidly. Crew and oarsmen could also carry oars, tholepin grommets, cushions and all the other props with them, when changing the ship, by leaving the first harbour with the first ship and by reaching another harbour where a second ship was ready to receive a new crew.
Trireme Oars were ca. 4.5 m in length. Tholepin grommets were of leather or rope.Trireme Oars Blades were flat.
In the package you will find:1- typical Ancient Greek Kilt Aa [Standard];2- typical Ancient Greek Kilt Ab [Sculpted];3- 1 Trireme Oar [4.5 m];4- 1 Rope Tholepin Grommet;5- 1 Cushion;6- 1 Headband;7- Complete SET ready for POSER 6 and Up JAMES character;8- Complete SET ready for DAZ MICHAEL 4 character;9- Complete SET ready for POSER 7 and Up SIMON G2 character;10- 15 Hi-Quality Hi-Def PhotoReal Textures [2072x2072; 1000x1000; 512x512; etc.];11- Alternate Textures to create different types of elements;12- Real World Scale SmartCgArt Man Reference System with models [C4D, VUE, 3DS, OBJ, DXF].
All the Models are prepared Hi-DEF and Photoreal, perfect for any type of Rendering!

Faithful and accurate Reconstruction of an Ancient Rome Ship-Prow Tortoise Siege Machinery to create an Ancient Rome Ship-Prow Tortoise, according to the Scientific Data and the Archaeological Evidence.

Source: Apollodorus, Poliorketika [proteichisma and tortoise like a ship's prow].

The Ship-Prow Tortoise was used by legionaries during siege against hill towns, to protect troops from heavy objects rolled downhill: tree trunks, boulders, wagons and barrels.

It was used in combination with a wood and branches fence system, to defend deep ditches [1.5 m] were the soldiers could gather, before reaching the inner section of the tortoise where they stayed safe crowded, until the moment of the direct attack.

The Wood and Branches Fence System was used also independently to protect the ditches.

description_text:
Ok . I am back , and this time with a horror product , or fantasy product , I know about the fantasy mimics creatures , first time I saw them it was in an old pc game named Nox , they where some kind of swan body with many spider legs , and tow arms in fronts with to blades , and the boxes some times turn into it , and it where so much strong , even stronger than golems , those who played the game understand that .
I thought it a creature made by the designers of the game , but later I got game named Torch light , and it is like nox but of course with more graphic , while nox contains more action that I loved nox more , in this game there is a pet and fishing holes , that you can fish kinds of fishes to feed them to your pet to transform it for a period of time to some creature , there were also treasure boxes that attacks you when you try opening it , it was not formidable like the one in Nox , but I got a fish and gave it to my pet and it transformed to this box , then I found in the instruction of this fish Makes your pet transform into a Mimic , then I knew that the Mimic is famouse creature in mythology .
Later I watched some anime named Owari no seraph , which the vampires counquered the world and they were so evil to the man kind , and enslaving them , even the kids , and they were invinceble against the human's weapons , but some team of them got some magical skills that can kill the vampires , that the heroes uses them to rebel against vampires , I do not remember any of those skills but one , the owner was training with the main hero , and summoned some large box , as soon as the hero got closer , the box opened a little and there was to glowing eyes withen it , then the hero stepped back immediatly , then I remembered the mimic , and this skill never used in the anime , because there is a new seasons because the story did not end at the last episode .
The week before I got an idea looks similar like all this , and it is this mimic that lives in trees , I still have more ideas of this creatures , but I am not sure if I will create them or not , because as you know I do not care this much about the work that brings back nothitng .

description_text:
EMT Aladin (German: Abbildende Luftgestützte Aufklärungsdrohne im Nächstbereich, airborne reconnaissance drone for close area imaging) is a small, man-portable light reconnaissance miniature unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) employed by the Bundeswehr (German Army).
An Aladin UAV of the German ArmyThe UAV can be radio-controlled via a portable control station, or fly according to previously set GPS coordinates. It features a day and night camera and video-relay. It can be transported in two suitcases, which contain the disassembled drone, and a backpack with the control station. The aircraft can be assembled and disassembled without tools in the field within five minutes.
The aircraft can be launched by hand or with a bungee catapult.
This UAV is used by the German Army in the northern part of Afghanistan. In May 2006, The Netherlands bought 10 Aladins for use in southern Afghanistan (Uruzgan), though in 2008 the Dutch program procured 24 systems of the AeroVironment Raven B.
Also Fennek reconnaissance vehicles of the German Army are equipped with Aladin UAVs.

description_text:
Mecha FriezaAfter being cut in half by his own attack and being caught in Namek's huge explosion, what remains of the still-living Frieza is salvaged and rebuilt with cybernetic enhancements by scientists under the order of King Cold; this form is referred to as Mecha Frieza (メカフリーザ) in video games. The whole of the lower half of his body and right side of his face are replaced, as is his left arm from the shoulder down, with scarring and metal accoutrements covering what little was left of his organic self. It is stated that these enhancements have made him even more powerful. However, he was never able to unleash his full power in this form, since he was quickly destroyed by Trunks.
Future TrunksTrunks first appears in chapter #331 The Young Boy of Mystery (謎の少年 Nazo no Shōnen), published in Weekly Shōnen Jump magazine on July 15, 1991.[1] Here he is a mysterious seventeen year old capable of transforming into the Super Saiyan state, who appears and singlehandedly kills Freeza and his father, King Cold.[4] Upon Goku's return from Planet Namek, Trunks confides in Goku his tragic story.[5]
As told in the stand-alone manga side story Trunks: The Story - The Lone Warrior (TRUNKS THE STORY －たったひとりの戦士－ Torankusu za Sutōrī -Tatta Hitori no Senshi-) and chapters #419 and 420,[6][7] Trunks has traveled from twenty years in the future where the world is in constant ruin due to the terror of the two androids #17 and #18 which were created by Doctor Gero, the former chief scientist of the Red Ribbon Army. By this time, Goku has succumbed to an unknown heart virus and everyone, with the exception of Gohan, has fallen at the hands of the artificial humans.[8] Trunks has been living with Bulma and secretly training with Gohan. After Gohan's inevitable death, Trunks assumes the mantle of Earth's sole protector against the artificial humans for the next three years until Bulma finishes her time machine. Once he informs Goku of the events to come, Trunks gives Goku a special medicine[8] and returns to his own time.[9]
Trunks returns to help in the present day battle against the artificial humans. With the appearance of Cell, Trunks trains with Vegeta in the Room of Spirit and Time. After Vegeta's defeat, Trunks fights Cell in his newly gained Perfect state. However, Trunks' new Super Saiyan grade proves to be ineffective so he willingly concedes. He later participates in Cell's martial arts tournament, where he is killed by Cell. After Cell's defeat, Trunks is restored with the Dragon Balls, upon which he returns to his own timeline in the future and defeats the artificial humans and Cell within his time.
Years later, Trunks encounters a new enemy known as Goku Black and is forced to retreat to the present timeline. He is shown to be able to reach Super Saiyan 2. During Goku and Goku Black's fight, Trunks' time machine is destroyed, leaving him stuck in the present era.[10] After a reunion with Gohan, who he sees content with being a family man in the presence of his wife Videl and daughter Pan, Trunks becomes encouraged to defeat Goku Black in order for the people of his own timeline to have a chance at that same happiness,[11] also having a reunion with Android #18.[12] Trunks then receives training from Vegeta, vowing to surpass both his father and Goku Black in strength.[13] Trunks then travels to the future to counter Goku Black (who is later revealed as Zamasu in Goku's body, but from another timeline),[14] dueling Zamasu (from Future Trunks' timeline) instead.[15] After his defeat, Trunks heals in the past and returns for a rematch. During the fight, Trunks becomes enraged when Goku Black blames him for all that has happened because of the use of the time machine, and transforms into an unknown Super Saiyan form. After numerous fights, including Goku Black and Zamasu fusing with the Potara earrings, Trunks gathers the energy from all remaining life on the planet into his sword and cuts Fusion Zamasu in half. Despite losing his body, Zamasu's essence began to envelop the entire universe, before being destroyed alongside the entire multiverse by that timeline's version of Zen-oh. Trunks and the others retreat to the past. Goku later invited Trunks to get Future Zen-Oh. The two go back, with Trunks and Mai bidding their farewells, returning afterward to a future timeline where Zamasu hasn't schemed his plans, and where there is an already existing Mai and Trunks, Bulma, and the comrades that were killed by Zamasu in Trunks' original universe.

description_text:
Created in Blender 2.93This model was originally designed for direct input into VRCHAT.
It will require:

  - VRCSDK3-AVATAR-2021.09.03.09.25_Public or higher

  - Dynamic Bones v.1.2.2 or higher

  - Muscle Animation Editor v.2.2 or higher (not needed for export, but may cause errors when importing .unitypackage)

  - Xiexe's Unity Shaders Rewritten

IMPORTANT NOTES:
The package has 4 scenes, split into two sections. 
The first section has Tasque and Tasque Quest. These have basic cloth simulation (Excluding the quest because it doesn't support it) in the dress. This may cause lag, so I would reccomend using the second section.   
The second section has Tasque No-Cloth and Tasque No-Cloth Quest These do not have cloth simulation, and are replaced with dynamic bones. If you do not want dynamic bones, you can remove them.
All scenes are identical, other than the quest variants having NO WHIP (as it is not supported), and the quest variants having supported VRCHAT mobile textures.
There is a thumbnail given in the files, but you can make your own with the VRCCAM :3

description_text:
Detailed and realistic male outfit 65
File formats provided are OBJ, FBX & DAE Texture maps: Diffuse: 8192x8192px, Normal: 4096x4096px
Clothing will eventually fit most avatars with minor adjustments.
How to fit the clothing to DAZ characters:

  - Dial Genesis 8 Male Arms Up-Down to -45% and Legs Spread to -5% in Parameters

  - Go into bone edit mode, and when bones are visible select one, right click and go edit -> bake joint rotations

  - Use the transfer utility, set source item shape to current and add a smoothing modifier.

  - Save the clothing to your library. 

  - Clear the scene, add G8 Male again and add the outfit, it should now fit the zero-posed character.

Hope this helps,
Enjoy!

This is a digital 3D printable model of Loki helmet
The download contains pieces of the model ready to be 3D printed on a 200 mm print bed.. All cut parts are placed on the print bed as we would print them to save you time.
SIZE
At 100% scale the model’s dimensions are approximately:
width: 172 mm
depth: 235 mm
You can scale the helmet as you wish to ensure a good fit, but we can’t guarantee that at a much smaller size the model will print well.
3D PRINTING SETTINGS
We use these settings for most of our prints:
Layer height 0.2 mm
Infill 15%
Supports 45°
For parts that are tall but have a small base, we use a 10 mm brim for better bed adhesion.
We try to make the models in a way that uses as little support material as possible.
This model is meant to be post-processed after printing. This can be gluing, sanding, painting, etc.
Printing settings will vary greatly depending on your specific printer.
Do you like the model and don’t have a 3D printer? There are lots of people who offer 3D printing services these days. Try searching for someone who offers them in your area.

description_text:
This is a digital 3D printable model of the Goblin Slayer helmet from the Goblin Slayer.
Included Files

  - STL (cut for 200mm printer beds)

  - STL (uncut for larger printers)

  - Assembled OBJ file (for easy scaling)

All cut parts are placed on the print bed just as we would print them, saving you time.
3D Model Dimensions

  - Width: 315 mm

  - Length: 265 mm

  - Height: 337 mm

Feel free to scale the model to fit your needs. Learn more about sizing and scaling for cosplay here.
Printer Settings

  - Layer height: 0.15 mm

  - Infill: 10% gyroid pattern

  - Supports: 30° organic

  - For taller parts, use a brim for better bed adhesion

Settings may vary depending on your printer, so treat these as a starting point.
No 3D printer? No problem! Search for your local 3D printing services.
This fan-made model was brought to life by 3Demon, a team of modeling and 3D printing enthusiasts based in Prague, Czech Republic. We’ve been creating 3D printable models for over a decade, from cosplay accessories to all sorts of interesting designs.
